These examined unit fixtures measure role-rule behavior on supplied parses, not parser accuracy or general semantic equivalence. No model is required to replay them. Uncovered-return and unmatched-compound-actors intentionally have no supported matching loan-role contradiction. A case may explicitly identify another frozen parser model for an alternative dependency attachment.
